name: Orientkoch
kurzbeschreibung:
**

An Oriental Chef in Tirol

** Discover the exotic flavors of the East in the heart of the Alps! Our **Orientkoch** in Tirol brings the vibrant tastes of the Middle East and Asia to your plate, blending traditional spices with local Alpine ingredients. Indulge in aromatic dishes like **Shawarma**, **Falafel**, and **Lamb Kebabs**, all prepared with passion and a touch of **Tiroler** hospitality. Whether you're craving a fragrant **Tagine** or a refreshing **Tzatziki**, our menu offers a journey through the Orient—right here in the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Pair your meal with a glass of **Grüner Veltliner** or a refreshing **Ayran** for the perfect fusion of East and West. Visit us in **Innsbruck**, **Kufstein**, or **Lienz**—where every bite tells a story of adventure and flavor! **

Come taste the world in Tirol!

**
